description.value: Oak Bay Seafood is a family-run fresh fish market and eat-in restaurant on Oak Bay Avenue, drawing on over four decades of hands-on fishing experience by owners Gregg and Anne Best. The kitchen serves made-from-scratch seafood including fish and chips, chowder, seasonal spot prawns, and steamed Dungeness crab, all sourced from local BC waters under Oceanwise sustainability guidelines. With outdoor seating and a combined deli and restaurant format, it makes a distinctive stop for cyclists touring the Oak Bay neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active fresh fish market and restaurant at 2024 Oak Bay Avenue Victoria BC. Takeout and GF options are explicitly stated on the website; OSM tag delivery=no conflicts with the website's mention of third-party delivery apps. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM addr:city is 'Oak Bay' but website consistently lists address as 'Victoria, BC'; Oak Bay is a separate municipality so OSM is technically correct, but the discrepancy may confuse users.
OSM tag delivery=no conflicts with website statement 'order for delivery through your favourite app', suggesting delivery is available via third-party apps.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible seafood restaurant and fish market with a functioning website and current seasonal content; a natural stop for touring cyclists on Oak Bay Avenue.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM note references a prior location as 'Cowichan Bay Seafood at Victoria Public Market'; the business has since relocated to 2024 Oak Bay Avenue and rebranded.
